lead.event: Foreign investors' 2026 net selling of Indonesian stocks reaches Rp84.99 trillion
lead.headline: Foreign investors’ 2026 net selling of Indonesian stocks reaches Rp84.99 trillion
lead.blurb: The outflow through 9 October exceeded the Rp53.84 trillion recorded in 2020 and Rp50.17 trillion in 2008. Analysts cite a strong US dollar, high US yields, Indonesia’s market mix and domestic concerns over transparency, free float and policy certainty. OJK and SRO have launched eight reform action plans, and investors await MSCI’s rebalancing announcement on 11 November.

deals_control.event: Jhonlin Baratama completes acquisition of 30.25% stake in Bayan Resources
deals_control.headline: Jhonlin completes acquisition of 30.25% of BYAN
deals_control.blurb: Jhonlin Baratama acquired 10.08 billion Bayan Resources shares from Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low for Rp26.10 trillion, at Rp2,588 each, with the transfer completed on 7 October. Low and Elaine retained direct stakes of 9.95% and 22.05%, respectively, and control of Bayan Resources did not change.

other.event: Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa secures Rp2.2 trillion coal hauling contract
other.headline: MAHA secures Rp2.2 trillion coal hauling contract
other.blurb: The four-year agreement with Ade Putra Tanrajeng appoints Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa as coal transportation services provider. It runs through 2030.

earnings_guidance.event: CGS International initiates AMMN coverage with Add rating and Rp7,000 target
earnings_guidance.headline: CGS initiates AMMN coverage with Add rating and Rp7,000 target
earnings_guidance.blurb: Analyst Joanne Ong's target implies 19.6x projected 2027 earnings. She forecasts 10% revenue CAGR and 29% EPS CAGR for 2026-28, citing higher ore grades at Batu Hijau and the smelter and refinery's full operation since July 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises ADRO profit forecasts and price target
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa lifts ADRO 2026 profit forecast by 4.3%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa also raised its price target on Alamtri, citing what its analysts view as a discounted valuation. It projects net profit of Rp600 billion in 2026, Rp714 billion in 2027 and Rp731 billion in 2028, after raising coking coal price assumptions to US$230, US$220 and US$200 per ton for those years, respectively, from US$170 previously.
